subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: Should this issue stay focused on mentioned Google Chat Space ingress, or should maintainers consolidate it into the broader Google Chat Space/thread/OAuth work?
rationale: Source review shows a narrow pre-session mention-gate failure path, but the durable product boundary affects Google Chat's default mention policy, diagnostics, and whether all-message/OAuth Space behavior belongs in a separate canonical issue.

options.title: Fix Mentioned-Space Ingress Here
options.body: Keep this issue canonical for @mentioned Space messages, require redacted live payload proof, and repair mention detection or diagnostics inside the Google Chat plugin while leaving all-message ingestion to the broader issue.

options.title: Consolidate With Broader Space Work
options.body: Move the remaining work under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/44347 if maintainers want one Google Chat Space umbrella that includes OAuth, all-message ingestion, and threading decisions.

options.title: Close As Classifier Fixed
options.body: Treat v2026.6.11 plus `requireMention:false` as sufficient, accepting that default @mention detection may still fail for some Space setups.

recommendation.title: Fix Mentioned-Space Ingress Here
recommendation.body: Keep this issue canonical for @mentioned Space messages, require redacted live payload proof, and repair mention detection or diagnostics inside the Google Chat plugin while leaving all-message ingestion to the broader issue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history on the shared mention policy and Google Chat ingress boundary that this decision depends on.
